title: REST API call
description: One tool that makes an HTTP call you describe. Put {placeholders} in the address or body: each becomes an argument the agent fills in.
setup_notes: For an authenticated API, add its credential first (Admin > Credentials) and give its name below; it is matched against the credential's allowed addresses on every call. The tool installs pending: approve it in Admin > Tools. Configure on the tool edits it afterwards.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Tool name
questions.help: Letters, digits and underscores, e.g. acme_get_order.

questions.name: description
questions.label: What the tool does
questions.help: Shown to the model when it decides whether to call it.

questions.name: body
questions.label: Body template (optional)
questions.help: JSON with {placeholders}, for POST, PUT and PATCH.

questions.name: credential
questions.label: Credential
questions.help: The name of an API credential, or no_auth for a public API.
